quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to operate a bicycle at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing.

obligation.description: Do not operate the bicycle at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing.

timing.description: Measure bicycle speed and the conditions during the same original episode.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing
judgment_calls_needed.note: The text supplies no numeric prudence threshold; actual conditions require source review.

parameter_refs.name: ego_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: observed bicycle speed in m/s, trace only

parameter_refs.name: commanded_approach_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: physical bicycle speed target in m/s, no legal threshold

parameter_refs.name: pedestrian_near_rack
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original absence or presence near rack
